audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty was written as a generic AD-assassin problem with no named cooldown, and the packet flagged that the matchup carries zero sequencing advice.
audit.why: Audacity is a 650-range dash on 11s falling to 7s, and Terrashape is a 1100-range dash on a flat 7s. She has two ways in, and Terrashape is the one that never goes away.
audit.corrected: Tricky at 7/10: Audacity is the commit, but Terrashape re-enters on a flat 7 seconds, so 'she used her dash' is only half true.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4], [5] and [6] all read 'Skill' while win[4] and win[5] read Qiyana and win[6] read Kassadin, and the full-layer whys for rows 4 and 5 described Kassadin taking over.
audit.why: Supreme Display of Talent at 6 and a Serrated Dirk spike keep those stages hers; the flip is two items.
audit.corrected: phases[4] and [5] set to Qiyana with matching whys, phases[6] set to Kassadin. Content win[] rows were already correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things were never stated: Supreme Display of Talent only stuns by detonating elements, and Force Pulse charges off spells cast nearby — which Qiyana supplies constantly.
audit.why: Riot's text says the shockwave 'detonates whatever elements she hits with it', and Force Pulse 'draws energy from spells cast in his vicinity'. Terrashape and Elemental Wrath are both on 7 seconds, so she charges your E for you.
audit.corrected: Her ultimate needs an element in the path to stun — away from walls, brush and her own Terrashape terrain it is far less lethal. And every spell she casts charges Force Pulse, so your slow is up more often here than in most lanes.

audit.why: Audacity 11/10/9/8/7, Terrashape a flat 7, Elemental Wrath a flat 7, Supreme Display of Talent a flat 120.
audit.corrected: Numbers written in, and the point that the 120-second ultimate is the real green light.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text used 'Grassland Terror' as if it were an ability, and wrote 'Rift Walk' for Riftwalk.
audit.why: Qiyana's abilities are Royal Privilege, Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal, Terrashape, Audacity and Supreme Display of Talent. 'Grassland Terror' is not among them.
audit.corrected: Replaced with Terrashape and the correct Riftwalk spelling.

audit.why: 55.78% across 744 games is consistent with losing six stages and owning the seventh.
